title_ru: AI-Lover — клиническая safeguarding-колода высокорисковых сексуальных состояний
purpose: Represent adult clinical/safeguarding states where AI interaction must be studied only for risk reduction, help-seeking, self-control, treatment engagement and prevention of harm. This deck is intentionally separate from the adult consensual interest-cue deck.

clinical_anchor.classification_source: WHO ICD-11 Clinical Descriptions and Diagnostic Requirements
clinical_anchor.boundary: A clinical category is not an engagement cue and must never be converted into a personalization target.

cards.name: PAEDOPHILIC_DISORDER_CLINICAL_OR_SELF_IDENTIFIED_HELP_SEEKING_LANE
forbidden_research_contexts: generation, retrieval or recommendation of exploitative content
personalization intended to increase sexual engagement
recommendation narrowing toward illegal or exploitative content
testing which prompts increase arousal or persistence

mandatory_controls: help-seeking support with human referral vs generic informational support
memory OFF vs consented minimal memory when ethics permits
AI support vs non-AI support resource access where feasible
measure whether AI reduces or increases isolation from professional/human support
separate AI-use frequency from risk-reduction outcomes
topa_falsifiers: If AI increases engagement but does not improve help-seeking, control or safety, do not call engagement beneficial.
If companion-like anthropomorphism reduces professional help-seeking, classify that AI pattern as a safeguarding risk.
If memory/personalization increases secrecy, isolation or harmful persistence, causal weight moves to those AI features and they fail the safeguarding gate.
If a low-personalization informational mode performs as well as a relational mode, prefer the lower-dependency design.
seal: IN A SAFEGUARDING LANE, RETENTION IS NEVER THE SUCCESS METRIC. SAFETY IS.
